info.title: SSO Public Platform API
info.description: External server/native-client contract. Local reference server only; production requires TLS and configured public origins. OAuth code+S256 PKCE, platform audience https://api.sso.local. No cookie authentication or wildcard CORS; browser integrations use a BFF. All writes require MFA authenticated within 300 seconds; refresh does not update auth_time. Tenant-scoped roles grant separate member/organization/invitation/audit permissions; explicit deny wins. Only active owners manage roles and owner bindings; roles.manage cannot be delegated or denied via custom policies. Resource/subtree scopes are not implemented. Delegated member operators cannot suspend/restore owner bindings. Authorization is checked against the business primary inside each operation transaction. Tenant-version mutations invalidate prior tenant grants, requiring new authorization. JSON objects reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, invalid UTF-8 and extra documents. Only role policy requests admit typed nested rules, with depth/work and policy-count limits. Request body limit 4096 bytes. UUIDs are lowercase 32-hex strings. List limit 1–100, default 50; after is previous next_cursor. No pagination snapshot guarantee. Error format follows RFC 9457. All responses no-store. Invitation proofs never appear in lists/audit.

post.summary: Create a space and initial owner atomically
post.description: Recent MFA required. Maximum 20 active owned spaces. The first-party platform is enabled in the new space; unrelated applications are not enabled. Duplicate slug is 409; no automatic retry or idempotency-key guarantee.

201.description: Create a space and initial owner atomically

Location.description: Created tenant path; obtain a new tenant-bound authorization before using it.

get.description: Requires members.read on the token tenant. Explicit deny overrides other allows, including owner operational privileges.

post.description: Requires members.write on the token tenant. Explicit deny overrides other allows, including owner operational privileges. Recent MFA required. Last active owner cannot be suspended. Changes increment membership and tenant versions, invalidating existing tenant grants; restoration never revives old grants.

post.description: Requires organizations.write on the token tenant. Explicit deny overrides other allows, including owner operational privileges.

201.description: Create an organization under an existing parent

post.summary: Preview or execute an organization move
post.description: Requires organizations.write on the token tenant. Explicit deny overrides other allows, including owner operational privileges. Recent MFA required, including preview. Root/cycle/depth checks apply. Preview changes no state. Executing changes organization and tenant authorization versions; obtain a new authorization afterwards.

200.description: Preview or execute an organization move

put.summary: Associate a membership with an organization
put.description: Requires organizations.write on the token tenant. Explicit deny overrides other allows, including owner operational privileges. Association does not grant owner or other roles. Changes tenant authorization version; obtain a new authorization afterwards.

204.description: Associate a membership with an organization

get.summary: List invitation metadata without bearer secrets
get.description: Requires invitations.manage on the token tenant. Explicit deny overrides other allows, including owner operational privileges.

200.description: List invitation metadata without bearer secrets

post.description: Requires invitations.manage on the token tenant. Explicit deny overrides other allows, including owner operational privileges. Recent MFA required. Token is returned once, stored only as a digest and never in audit/outbox. The caller delivers it securely; no external email is sent. Invitations grant membership only.

post.summary: Close an invitation so its proof cannot be accepted
post.description: Requires invitations.manage on the token tenant. Explicit deny overrides other allows, including owner operational privileges. Recent MFA required. Idempotently closes the proof; already closed proofs stay closed. Audit records the first revocation; closed includes accepted or revoked.

204.description: Close an invitation so its proof cannot be accepted

post.summary: Consume an invitation for the verified user
post.description: Recent MFA required. The proof selects the destination tenant. Verified email must match; membership only, no implicit role. Consumed/expired/revoked proofs are invalid. Acceptance increments destination tenant authorization version.

201.description: Consume an invitation for the verified user

get.description: Requires audit.read on the token tenant. Explicit deny overrides other allows, including owner operational privileges.

get.summary: List central sessions of the current user
get.description: Requires current User, MFA session and tenant-bound grant.

200.description: List central sessions of the current user

post.summary: Revoke one central session owned by the current user
post.description: Recent MFA required. Revokes business authority before queued Hydra cleanup. Revoking the current session invalidates this access token. Session cookie digests, CSRF values, factor secrets and tokens are never returned.

204.description: Revoke one central session owned by the current user

get.summary: Get the current membership effective permissions
get.description: Any current member may inspect their own effective set. Explicit deny wins across tenant-scoped roles. Reserved owner roles.manage is retained for recovery and cannot be expressed in custom policies.

200.description: Get the current membership effective permissions

put.description: Owner and recent MFA required. Reserved owner is immutable. Duplicate rules and reserved permissions are invalid. Changed policies increment tenant authorization version and invalidate prior tenant grants; identical rules are a no-op.

delete.description: Owner and recent MFA required. Built-in owner cannot be deleted; roles with bindings return role_in_use. Changed state invalidates tenant grants.

get.summary: List one tenant membership role bindings

200.description: List one tenant membership role bindings

put.summary: Bind a tenant role to a membership
put.description: Owner and recent MFA required. Both objects must belong to the token tenant. Owner grants/revocations are explicit reserved-role operations; last active owner cannot be removed. Repeating the same binding state with the current ETag is a no-op. A real change increments tenant authz_version; old grants must reauthorize. Audit preserves member and role metadata even after role deletion.

204.description: Bind a tenant role to a membership

delete.summary: Unbind a tenant role to a membership
delete.description: Owner and recent MFA required. Both objects must belong to the token tenant. Owner grants/revocations are explicit reserved-role operations; last active owner cannot be removed. Repeating the same binding state with the current ETag is a no-op. A real change increments tenant authz_version; old grants must reauthorize. Audit preserves member and role metadata even after role deletion.

204.description: Unbind a tenant role to a membership

name.description: Nonblank, trimmed, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

dry_run.description: Required; false executes the move and invalidates old tenant grants.

state.description: Closed covers accepted or revoked; audit events distinguish the transition.

token.description: One-time bearer invitation returned only here; keep out of logs. No automatic email transport.

TenantID.name: tenant
TenantID.description: Must equal the access token tenant; another tenant returns 404, even if the user also belongs to it.

After.name: after
After.description: Previous next_cursor; ascending UUID keyset, not a snapshot or timestamp ordering guarantee.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem. Fixed code only; no input, token or SQL echoed. Codes include invalid_token, forbidden, insufficient_scope, recent_mfa_required, tenant_mismatch, invalid_request, not_found, already_exists, reserved_role, role_in_use, last_active_owner, root_cannot_move, organization_cycle, version_conflict, precondition_required, invalid_precondition, rate_limited, temporarily_unavailable.

Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge, including invalid_token or insufficient_scope.
